description: Bridge in original, undamaged reference condition under normal operational ambient vibration.
modal_indicators: 1st vertical bending mode stable at ~3.85 Hz, torsional modes consistent.

description: Lowering of intermediate pier P1 by 20 mm to simulate differential foundation settlement.
affected_elements: Pier P1, intermediate bearing assemblies, adjacent girder span
modal_indicators: Slight downward shift in 1st bending mode (~3.78 Hz), minor static tilt offset on pier channels.

description: Lowering of intermediate pier P1 by 40 mm.
modal_indicators: Clear modal frequency decrease (~3.68 Hz), measurable strain asymmetry between north and south girders.

description: Severe differential settlement of pier P1 by 80 mm and subsequently 95 mm.
affected_elements: Pier P1 foundation, bearings, continuous box-girder hinge
modal_indicators: 1st vertical bending mode drops below 3.50 Hz, high cross-axis coupling on lateral channels.

description: Lifting of pier and artificial tilting of the foundation pad.
modal_indicators: Torsional mode frequency shift, asymmetry in transverse accelerometer responses.

description: Chipping and removal of 12 m² concrete cover at the girder soffit to simulate freeze-thaw spalling.
modal_indicators: High-frequency impulse bursts, increased kurtosis on localized soffit sensors 12-16.

description: Extension of soffit concrete spalling to 24 m².
modal_indicators: Sustained elevation in spectral entropy and localized energy dissipation across high frequencies.

description: Simulated slope failure/landslide movement of 1 m against the bridge abutment.
affected_elements: Abutment, approach embankment, end wing walls
modal_indicators: Low-frequency boundary condition stiffness change, noticeable DC axis shift on abutment sensors.

description: Mechanical failure/disruption of the concrete pendulum hinge at the bridge abutment.
modal_indicators: Shift in rotational stiffness, significant variation in vertical deck mode shapes.

description: Controlled failure of 2 to 4 prestressing cable anchor heads.
modal_indicators: Localized tension loss, sudden shift in high-order beam bending frequencies.

description: Cutting and progressive rupture of 2 to 6 post-tensioning steel tendons inside the box girder.
affected_elements: Internal post-tensioning tendons, main span longitudinal flexural capacity
modal_indicators: Substantial global stiffness reduction, fundamental bending frequency drops significantly across mid-span sensors.
